learnings: Tool errors (API failures, model breakdowns) on non-security-critical files should not block a verdict
.gitignore and similar metadata files should be classified as low-priority and not cause inconclusive verdicts when they fail to analyze
The audit tool should detect model breakdowns (gibberish output) and exclude those reports rather than marking them as inconclusive
